metadata.name: stage5-slurm-pilot-bringup
metadata.description: Bring up the first RFC99 SLURM controller and one first worker without depending on X12AGAIN reimage.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible root containing profile definitions, roles, and inventory.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Inventory containing the SLURM controller and first worker targets.

variables.name: worker_target
variables.description: First disposable worker target for initial SLURM validation.

variables.name: control_flow_root
variables.description: Directory for checkpoint JSONL control-flow output.

stages.summary: Confirm SLURM pilot does not depend on X12AGAIN before controller work starts.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Gate: Do not block SLURM on X12AGAIN reimage; X12AGAIN joins only after workstation+hypervisor+RDMA E2ET.'

stages.summary: Validate DNS and NetBox intent for sched-sun99-slurmctl-099071 at 172.16.99.71.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Validate DNS A/CNAME and NetBox VM/service records for sched-sun99-slurmctl-099071.rfc1918.host 172.16.99.71 before runtime mutation.'

stages.summary: Confirm MUNGE and slurmdbd secrets are delivered by vault and not committed in plaintext.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Validate vault_slurm_munge_key and vault_slurmdbd_storage_password before starting munge, slurmdbd, slurmctld, or slurmd.'

stages.summary: Render the vm-slurm-controller profile and SLURM controller OpenRC service intent.
Render the first slurm-worker-node profile and slurmd OpenRC service intent.
Confirm Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, rsyslog, and Elasticsearch targets are defined for the pilot.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Validate scheduler telemetry targets: Prometheus scrape, VictoriaMetrics storage, Grafana dashboard, rsyslog log routing, Elasticsearch full-text log search.'

stages.summary: Run the first runtime smoke checks after controller and worker are online.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Runtime smoke: sinfo; scontrol show nodes; srun hostname; sbatch --wrap="hostname; date -u"; verify slurmctld slurmdbd slurmd services.'

stages.summary: Hold Project Coherent Flash to simulation modeling until SLURM can submit repeatable jobs.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Project Coherent Flash modeling gate: KV prefix cache, object/model tier, RAG vector tier, synthetic RDMA/NVMe-oF/NFS probes, BlueField2 DPU boundary on X12AGAIN after reimage.'
